description: This Java class `ClientFamilyMembersWritePlatformServiceImpl` is a service implementation responsible for managing client family members, including adding, updating, and deleting family member records within the Fineract platform. It handles JSON-based commands to perform these operations and interacts with repositories and deserializers.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: This class implements the service interface for managing client family members, providing methods to add, update, and delete family member records based on JSON commands.

methods.name: addFamilyMember
methods.description: Adds a new family member to a client based on JSON parameters, performing validation and persisting the new record.

methods.name: addClientFamilyMember
methods.description: Adds multiple family members to a client from a JSON array, parsing each member's details and persisting them.

methods.name: updateFamilyMember
methods.description: Updates an existing family member record with new data from a JSON command.

methods.name: deleteFamilyMember
methods.description: Deletes a specified family member record from the database.
